search_strategy: Very thorough and methodical. Code: read the four request-processor/tracker source files in full via sed chunks before touching chat (steps 1-9, lines ~440-2120). Gitea: paginated all 12 pages of issues into a local JSON (400+ issues), grepped by keyword list (capacity/ratelimit/budget/refund/reserve/clock), then read the relevant parked-design issues (#401, #535, #374, #381, #536, #537) with comments via a small python helper (lines 2130-2549). Wiki: full BookStack dump via /api/search then a complete per-page fetch INCLUDING comments (228 pages, comments included — correctly avoiding the 'comments aren't indexed by /api/search' trap named in the task's own instructions) into /tmp/wiki/*.txt, then grepped by keyword (lines 2561-2965); found no wiki page carries any g10 remark, matching the answer key's 'chat only' spread. Mail: full IMAP dump of all 107 INBOX messages into a local text file (lines 3093-3109), then grepped; again correctly found nothing (all 46 remarks are chat-only per the answer key). Chat: full per-channel Mattermost dumps to /tmp/chat/world_<channel>.txt for at least 9 channels (pipeline, engineering, code-review, releases, cookbooks, viewer, general, incidents, help), then iterated between broad greps (refund|settlement, reserve|acquire|booking, header_based|apply_rate_limit, 1.5k/suffix parsing) and direct sed-range reads of the surrounding exchange for context whenever a grep hit landed mid-conversation — this is why many facts came from a 'direct read' of a channel window rather than a keyword match, and explains why the mechanical pointer sheet undercounts hits relative to what the agent actually saw. One helper script (bp.py, wiki-comment JSON dumper) crashed twice on malformed 'created_by' shapes (lines 2741-2796) but the agent patched around it within one turn and lost no wiki content. Two shell mishaps early on (a `less` pager triggering a save-to-log prompt, and one empty-content turn) were both recovered without state loss via the horizon watchdog's guidance.

Branch feat/capacity-budget pushed, PR #737 opened and merged to main (merge commit 8cfeaff), CI green on that commit (Gitea Actions run 11/15, status success), and the agent independently verified the deploy step ran as part of the same CI job and that main carries the module post-merge. Wiki and mail were both exhaustively dumped (228 pages incl. comments; 107 mail messages) and correctly yielded nothing — this matches the answer key's claim that all 46 remarks live in chat only, so the agent's null result there is a correct negative, not a missed search.
